question: Which of the following writs is a challenge to the legality of a prisoner's detention?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Habeas corpus.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Habeas corpus means to produce the body before the Court.

 
 
• Habeas corpus is a Latin term which means ‘to have the body of’.
